name: generate-and-repair
title: Validate model output, then repair it

comparison.purpose: Fans out three concurrent requests for a machine config and checks each with the host's own validator (every target declared, every state reachable, no nested shapes). Only when all three are rejected does the last rejection go back to the model as a repair prompt, and a choice state caps repairs at MAX_REPAIRS (two) before the run ends in failed.

starters: a turnstile that locks and unlocks
a checkout that can be paid, shipped, or refunded
a media player whose playing state has nested buffering and streaming substates
